content: Management plans for diabetes should be tailored to the individual’s health status and personal goals. These plans should evolve over time, taking into account the patient’s specific needs, the presence of other medical conditions (comorbidities), and their overall life expectancy. Ongoing research is being conducted to improve diabetes management in older adults, particularly in those who are frail or in end-of-life care situations. In such cases, the primary focus may shift away from strict glycemic control and instead prioritize enhancing the patient’s quality of life and alleviating symptoms.
